tile.name: ELIZA
tile.desc: The 1966 chatbot, its scripts, and a mesh vocabulary

menu.title: ELIZA
menu.subtitle: Weizenbaum's 1966 program with every script that survives, and one for the mesh. Runs in your browser; type *help in any of them for the commands.
menu.about: Anthony and Max Hay's recreation of ELIZA, fetched from github.com/anthay/ELIZA and adapted by adapt_eliza.py; each entry opens eliza.html?script=NAME. The banner is the one in its source (eliza.cpp, eliza.html).

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1966
entries.desc: The famous one, as printed in the January 1966 CACM paper. Type *cacm to replay the paper's conversation

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1965 (MIT archive, tape 100)
entries.desc: The earlier DOCTOR, from a listing printed on 6 March 1965 in Weizenbaum's papers

entries.name: DOCTOR on the mesh
entries.desc: The 1965 DOCTOR with the box's own keywords: mesh, node, LoRa, antenna, battery, firmware, signal

entries.name: DOCTOR, 1965 (tape 102), as printed
entries.desc: The other script in that listing. It does not run as printed: one line is out of place, and ELIZA says where

entries.name: DOCTOR en français
entries.desc: The 1966 DOCTOR translated for the Jeu de Paume's 2025 exhibition, Le monde selon l'IA

entries.name: YAPYAP
entries.desc: From a 1965 pilot study by Quarton, McGuire and Lorch, adapted to run on 1966 ELIZA

entries.name: YAPYAP, as printed
entries.desc: The study's script before adaptation. It needs features 1966 ELIZA lacks, so it does not run

entries.name: Turing machine: equal As and Bs
entries.desc: ELIZA as a computer. Type EQUAL A B B A (YES) or EQUAL A A A B B (NO)

entries.name: Turing machine: palindromes
entries.desc: Type PALP A B B A (TRUE) or PALP A A A B B (FALSE)

entries.name: Turing's Example I (1936)
entries.desc: Computes 010101… as in On Computable Numbers, and never stops. Type *tracepre to watch the tape, then EX1; *maxtran 0 lifts the 500-step limit, Escape stops it

entries.name: Turing's Example II (1936)
entries.desc: Computes 001011011101111…, and never stops. Type *tracepre, then EX2; *maxtran 0 lifts the 500-step limit, Escape stops it

addon.title: ELIZA (chatbot)
addon.summary: Weizenbaum's 1966 ELIZA, with every script that survives and a few Irate-Box keywords, from Anthony and Max Hay's github.com/anthay/ELIZA at the commit this hub pins. It runs in the visitor's browser: about 250 KB on disk, no service and no memory use on the box.
addon.consent: This downloads ELIZA from github.com/anthay/ELIZA, where its authors publish it, and serves it to everyone on the box's network. Some of its scripts are not openly licensed: the 1966 DOCTOR is (c) ACM, its French translation is based on it, and YAPYAP is reproduced with the Harold Garfinkel Archive's permission. The copy on this box is yours. Add it?
